rationale.conceptual: The method is established (classical MD with a reactive potential), but requires non-trivial implementation: constructing the GH helicoid geometry (turn number 6, appropriate dimensions) and the MLG slab, setting up constant-velocity tensile loading at 300 K with specific fixed/loading groups, and recording force and strain energy. This goes beyond a simple textbook operation.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves building atomistic models, installing and configuring LAMMPS with the AIREBO potential, running two separate deformation simulations, collecting output data, and post-processing to extract failure strains. This requires multiple stages, proper environment setup, and correct handling of simulation outputs.
